name: Hudson Country Montessori Summer Camp
description_short: A Montessori school's summer camp in New Rochelle for toddlers from 18 months through age 12, grouped as toddlers, preschool (3 to 5), juniors (6 to 8) and seniors (9 to 12). Weeks follow a theme and include swim lessons in the on site pool, sports, cooking, music, gardening and STEAM, with field trips for the older groups.
refund_policy_summary: A $220 deposit is due with the application; deposits and tuition are non refundable.
notes: 2026 full day (9 to 4, five days) is $680 a week for ages 2.6 to 12 and $830 for toddlers; half day mornings for toddlers and preschool are $625 and $510; 2 to 4 day options available for the younger groups. Early session from 7:30 is $130 a week; late sessions to 6 are $90 to $214. Catered lunch is available for a fee. A counselor in training program serves ages 13 to 15. Discounts for siblings, current Hudson students and police, fire and military families. 2027 dates and rates are not posted yet.
